args: Voluntary stop after satisfying stage 3 pastry goals; not blocked. Opening causal chains were intuitive but routine. Failed dough plus yeast taught the receiving-item placement rule clearly, and I generalized it to yogurt and pastry. Optional fruit yogurt and bread and butter were the most satisfying discoveries because they answered my own ideas rather than a quota. Humoral book plus modern nutrition note failed; one hint led to the menu branch, whose abstract annotation was less rewarding than a concrete historical example would have been. Butter into flour versus dough was recognizable, but the repeated place-combine-bake pattern now feels routine. I do not feel enough curiosity to continue to snack cake today. This is one source-blind logical-interface agent playtest, not a human enjoyment claim.
